description: This Java class 'HttpPushValidator' provides validation logic for HTTP push connection configurations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It checks URI schemes, target addresses, HTTP methods, and parallelism settings, and throws exceptions for invalid configurations.

classes.name: HttpPushValidator
classes.description: Validator class for HTTP push connection configurations, ensuring correct URI schemes, HTTP methods, and parallelism settings.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of HttpPushValidator.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, which is HTTP_PUSH.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the connection, headers, and actor system, including URI scheme, source, target, payload mappings, and parallelism.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Ensures that the connection does not have a source, as per HTTP push connection rules.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, including header mapping, address template, and target address format.

methods.name: validateTargetAddress
methods.description: Validates the target address, ensuring it contains a valid HTTP method and path.

methods.name: validateHttpMethod
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP method in the target address is supported (PUT, PATCH, POST).

methods.name: validateParallelism
methods.description: Validates the 'parallelism' setting in the specific configuration, ensuring it is a positive integer.

methods.name: parallelismValidationFailed
methods.description: Constructs an exception for invalid parallelism values.

methods.name: isSecureScheme
methods.description: Checks if a URI scheme is HTTPS.
